payload.title: File:Strophodus.png
payload.credit_html: A new hybodontiform shark (Strophodus Agassiz 1838) from the Lower Cretaceous (Valanginian-Hauterivian) of Colombia
payload.description_html:
Teeth of Strophodus rebecae sp. nov. and Strophodus sp. from the Rosa Blanca Formation.
(A1–B4) Anterolateral teeth (A1–A4): UR-CP-0129; (B1–B4): UR-CP-0130). (C1–F4). Lateral teeth (C1–C5): holotype UR-CP-0131; (D1–D4): UR-CP-0136; (E1–E4): UR-CP-0135; (F1–F4): UR-CP-0133). (C5). Close-up of the occlusal ornamentation in the holotype UR-CP-0131. (G1–H2). Fragmented lateral teeth of Strophodus sp. (G1–G2): UR-CP-0134; H1–H2: UR-CP-0132). View: basal (B2, C2, F2,) distal (A4), labial (A3, D2, E2, F3, G2), lingual (C3, D3, E3, F4, H2), occlusal (A1, B1, C1, D1, E1, F1, C5, G1, H1), mesial (C4, D4, E4), mesio-labial (B4), mesio-lingual (A2, B3).
